status: draft-review-only; not deployed; no production database mutations

implemented.ledger: Retained source versions, deterministic event fingerprints and same-day occurrence counts; duplicate multiplicity conflicts are disclosed. Index covers the current and up to two recent committed statements; no lifetime completeness claim.
implemented.statementXirr: Opening units and running balances from the documented provider schema are preserved. Only supported zero-opening, dated, unit-reconciled source statements can produce ACT/365 annualized cash-flow XIRR. Non-conventional sign patterns abstain.
implemented.lots: FIFO source-amount analysis for reconciled purchases and redemptions. Unsupported corporate actions and reinvestment basis block results. No legal tax-basis certification, tax liability or exit-load estimate.
implemented.planning: Saved goals, self-reported investment preferences, manual monthly SIP schedules and user-entered category targets, with validation, owner RLS and optimistic save revisions.
implemented.scenarios: Contribution-only goal illustrations and corrected annual-effective SIP projections; no promised return or auto-assigned allocation.
implemented.navResearch: Local AMFI-text history parser and comparison on exact common dates, interactive chart inspection, explicit NAV-only scope and no gap filling.
implemented.overlapResearch: Local user-supplied dated security-weight CSV comparison, exact ISIN matching and sum-of-minimum-weights overlap with unknown coverage retained.
implemented.exports: Authenticated holdings CSV and evidence JSON; masked folios, explicit export scope, formula-injection protection and private/no-store responses.
implemented.providerConnection: Documented CASParser CAMS/KFintech email-statement request enabled in the existing consent-based widget. This does not establish ongoing sync or universal mobile-only retrieval.
implemented.jev: Optional typed question-to-topic routing behind three separate environment settings and explicit question-sharing consent. Only the submitted question goes to TypeSafe; fixed evidence templates supply answer facts. Separate five-attempt rolling 24-hour budget, timeout, schema/confidence checks and unavailable fallback. No live paid model calls performed.
implemented.reliability: Bounded upstream streaming reads, redirect rejection for credentialed calls, ambiguous NAV-identifier rejection, complete supported-size transaction pagination, table pagination, request IDs and sanitized failure metadata. Aborted and URL-changed client reads cannot reuse another resource's data.
